summary: Tested photo upload (backend + frontend), phone validation (signup + vehicle form), and admin flat-reset feature end-to-end. All 12 backend tests pass. Frontend flows all verified: bad phone rejected with toast in both AuthDialog signup and VehicleForm; inline phone-error appears on blur; photo picker upload creates preview + remove button; vehicle card renders photo-<id>; admin sees admin-users-panel with vehicle_count; reset-dialog opens, confirm removes resident+vehicles, row disappears, and same flat can be re-registered.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _validate_photo compares len(photo) (data-URL character length) against MAX_PHOTO_BYTES=700000. This bounds size roughly but is not exact byte count of the underlying image. Acceptable given client already caps at 700KB data URL length.
GET /api/admin/users iterates users and issues one count query per user (N+1). Fine for 60-flat scope; consider $lookup/aggregation if scaled.
In VehicleForm, `payload.photo = form.photo || ''` sends empty string to server for cleared photo which correctly maps to None in backend. Good pattern.
AdminUsersPanel: onAfterReset callback fires after local list refresh -- Home refreshes directory too. Clean.
